item.arcane_artifacts.wreath_of_manipula: After 5 hits of one damage type, adapts to it for 3-6 minutes:
physical - Resistance, fire/lava - Fire Resistance, suffocation/drowning - Water Breathing, magic - Arcane Adaptation.
4 s without damage: Regeneration I for 5 s.
Removes a curable harmful effect that lasts 5 s (20 s cooldown).
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_boots.des: Inscribe a Self spell at the Scribes Table.
Crouch to cast it on yourself, paid with your mana.
A new spell replaces the old one.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_gloves.de: Spells you cast that begin with the gloves' pattern are cast twice for the price of one.
Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table to change the pattern.
3 s cooldown after each free cast.
item.arcane_artifacts.ring_of_reversal.d: Each hit you take stores 3 charge (at most once per second, up to 100).
Charge slowly turns into mana: 10 charge = 2 mana.
Ignores very weak and self-inflicted hits.
item.arcane_artifacts.mantle_of_reflecti: 15% chance to send a hostile magical projectile back at its caster.
Does not reflect arrows, melee attacks or explosions.
arcane_artifacts.boots.invalid: The boots only accept spells with the Self form.
arcane_artifacts.gloves.invalid: The gloves need a spell that starts with a form.
death.attack.arcane_artifacts.parasitic_: %1$s withered away as a parasite's host
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_arcane: Launches an arcane missile that seeks the nearest hostile creature within 16 blocks, preferring creatures bearing an Arcane Mark, and chases it. It never targets its caster, the caster's team, tamed pets or summons, cannot pass through blocks and gives up a chase after a few seconds. Without a target it flies straight and fades away.

Brands the target with an arcane mark for 8 seconds, visible to every player. A creature can bear only one mark; marking it again refreshes the mark. Arcane Missiles and split projectiles prefer marked creatures.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_parasi: Binds the struck creature to you with a parasitic link for 8 seconds. While the link holds, every source of damage aimed at you strikes the host instead - before your armor or resistances apply, and with the host's own armor and resistances applied. The link breaks if the host dies or moves more than 32 blocks away. One link at a time; 20 second cooldown. Redirected damage is never redirected again.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_splitt: When a projectile augmented with Splitting strikes a creature, it splits into two smaller homing projectiles that deal half damage and seek other nearby targets. Split projectiles never split again and do not strike the creature the original projectile hit.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_pursui: Sharpens the senses of homing projectiles: each Pursuit widens the target search radius, makes the projectile turn more sharply and lets it fly longer. Pursuit never increases damage.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_arcane_mi: The missile passes through an additional target or block.
The missile also collides with plants and other non-solid blocks.
Wider search radius, sharper turns and a longer lifetime.
On hitting a creature, splits into two half-damage missiles that seek other targets.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_arcane_ma: Increases the duration of the mark.
Decreases the duration of the mark.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_projectil: On hitting a creature, splits into two half-damage homing projectiles that seek other targets.
arcane_artifacts.page1.overview: Arcane Artifacts adds five accessories worn in Curios slots and five glyphs. Each accessory is a new way to play rather than a stat bonus: the Wreath adapts to the damage you take, the Boots and Gloves carry spells, the Ring turns pain into Source, the Mantle sends hostile magic back.
arcane_artifacts.page2.overview: Accessories are crafted on the Enchanting Apparatus from real Ars Nouveau materials and Rose Gold, a copper-gold alloy made at the crafting table. You can wear only one copy of each accessory: a second identical accessory cannot be equipped. Most cooldowns are shown on the item in its slot like any item cooldown.
arcane_artifacts.page3.overview: The glyphs are learned at the Scribes Table like every other glyph and appear in the glyph index by tier: Arcane Missile (form, II), Arcane Mark (effect, I), Parasitism (effect, III), Splitting and Pursuit (projectile augments, II). Their pages explain in detail how they work and how they combine with the accessories.
arcane_artifacts.page1.rose_gold_ingot: An alloy of copper and gold. Crafting table, shapeless: 4 copper ingots and 4 gold ingots give 2 Rose Gold Ingots. Any copper and gold ingots from the c:ingots tags work. Rose gold stabilises the enchantments of every artifact of this addon and is also used for the Splitting glyph.
arcane_artifacts.page1.wreath_of_manipul: Worn on the head. The Wreath studies the damage you suffer and adapts your body to it. It counts separate hits for six damage categories: physical, fire, lava, suffocation, drowning and magic. Falling, starvation, the void and /kill are never counted.
arcane_artifacts.page2.wreath_of_manipul: Adaptation: after 5 hits of one category the Wreath adapts to it for a random 3 to 6 minutes. Physical: Resistance. Fire and lava: Fire Resistance. Suffocation and drowning: Water Breathing. Magic: Arcane Adaptation (magic damage reduced by 25%). Each category has its own counter and timer. While adapted, that counter stays at zero; when the adaptation ends it disappears and you need 5 new hits. Only damage you really took counts: standing in lava counts at the normal hurt rate, damage fully redirected by Parasitism does not count.
arcane_artifacts.page3.wreath_of_manipul: Recovery: if you take no damage for 4 seconds, the Wreath grants Regeneration I for 5 seconds. Any new damage restarts the timer. Cleansing: when a harmful effect that milk could cure (poison, wither, weakness, slowness, hunger...) has stayed on you for 5 seconds without interruption, the Wreath removes it. One effect per cleanse, then a 20 second cooldown.
arcane_artifacts.page4.wreath_of_manipul: Reading the Wreath: its flowers form four groups - silver for physical, orange for fire and lava, turquoise for suffocation and drowning, violet for magic. Grey flowers are dormant, they colour in as hits accumulate and shine brightly while the adaptation is active. Other players see the colours on your head. The tooltip lists every counter and the time left on each adaptation. The adaptation is stored in the Wreath itself and survives death and travel with it.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_boots: Worn in the feet slot. The Boots hold one spell whose form must be Self. Inscribe it like any caster: place the Boots on the Scribes Table and use your spell book on it. A new spell replaces the old one; spells with any other form are refused.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_boots: Starting to crouch casts the inscribed spell on yourself. Holding crouch casts only once; release and crouch again to cast again. The cast goes through the normal spell system: the spell is validated, your mana discounts apply, the mana is paid from your pool, and with too little mana nothing happens and you see the usual message.
arcane_artifacts.page3.focusing_boots: An internal cooldown of 1 second prevents crouch-spamming. Spells cast by the Boots are never repeated by the Focusing Gloves. Good choices: Self + Heal, Self + Leap, Self + Blink, Self + Shield-type effects for an instant defensive reflex.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_gloves: Worn in the hands slot. The Gloves hold a spell pattern - Projectile by default. Whenever you cast a spell normally (spell book, wand, staff...) whose glyphs begin with that pattern, the spell is cast a second time, free of charge, a few ticks later.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_gloves: Example: Projectile - Harm costs 10 mana. With the Gloves you launch two projectiles and pay 10 mana once. The repeat happens only after the first cast really succeeded and paid its mana, so a failed cast gives nothing. The repeat never spends mana and never triggers another repeat, so it can not chain. Both casts use exactly the same spell. After a free repeat the Gloves need 3 seconds to recover.
arcane_artifacts.page3.focusing_gloves: Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table to change the pattern; it must start with a form. A longer pattern is stricter: Arcane Missile - Parasitism only doubles that exact opening. The repeat is cast from where you stand and look at that moment, which suits Projectile, Arcane Missile and Self; a Touch repeat cast into the air does nothing. A doubled Parasitism never creates two links or extends one.
arcane_artifacts.page1.ring_of_reversal: Worn as a ring. Each hit you take stores 3 charge in the Ring, up to 100. While worn, every second 10 charge become 2 mana, as long as your mana is not full. The charge is stored on the Ring and shown as a bar on the item.
arcane_artifacts.page2.ring_of_reversal: The Ring can not be farmed: at most one charging hit per second, hits under 1 damage and self-inflicted damage are ignored, and only damage that really reached you counts (armour, invulnerability frames and redirection are applied first). The one-second limit is saved on you, so logging out does not reset it.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mantle_of_reflect: Worn on the back. When a hostile magical projectile is about to hit you, the Mantle has a 15% chance to send it back toward the creature that launched it. After a reflection the Mantle needs 12 seconds to recover.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mantle_of_reflect: Reflected: every Ars Nouveau spell projectile, including Arcane Missiles (they re-target their caster), plus projectiles listed in the arcane_artifacts:reflectable_projectiles tag (blaze and dragon fireballs by default). Never reflected: arrows and other physical projectiles, melee attacks, explosions, projectiles without a living owner, and projectiles from allies. The reflected projectile becomes yours and keeps its spell and speed - it is not amplified.
arcane_artifacts.page1.status_effects: These status effects come from the glyphs and the Wreath. The Parasitism effects only display the state of a link and can not be removed with milk; the link itself decides when they end.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.arcane_mark: Placed by the Arcane Mark glyph for 8 seconds. A rune circle turns above the marked creature and every player can see it. A creature carries only one mark; marking it again refreshes it. Arcane Missiles and split projectiles choose marked creatures first. Harmful and curable: milk or Dispel remove it.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasite_hos: The creature is the host of a parasitic link: all damage aimed at the caster hits it instead, with its own armour and resistances. A tether of particles joins it to the caster. Ends when the link breaks.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_bo: Shown on the caster while a parasitic link is active. Damage aimed at you is moved to the host before your armour and resistances apply. Void damage and /kill are never moved.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_re: The Parasitism cooldown: 20 seconds from the moment a link is created. Casting a spell with Parasitism during the cooldown is refused before any mana is spent.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.arcane_adapt: Granted by the Wreath of Manipulation when it adapts to magic. Reduces magic damage (magic, wither, dragon breath, sonic boom and Ars Nouveau spell damage) by 25%, after armour.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_arcane_: How it works: the missile scans 16 blocks around it (more with Pursuit) every few ticks and picks a target in this order: creatures with an Arcane Mark, then monsters and mobs attacking you, then others - the nearest one in each group. It never picks you, your team, your tamed pets or summons, players when PvP is off, or anything behind a wall. It steers toward the target every tick, so it can curve around. If it chases one target for 5 seconds without hitting it, it gives up on that creature for good. Without a target it flies straight; it fades after 10 seconds. On impact it resolves the rest of the spell like a Projectile, and Pierce, Split, Accelerate, Decelerate and Sensitive work as usual. Combos: Arcane Missile - Arcane Mark tags enemies for later missiles; Arcane Missile - Parasitism attaches a link from range; add Splitting and Pursuit for a swarm.

How it works: the mark is a status effect, so it is synced to every player and shows as a rotating rune circle. Only one mark exists per creature: a second mark refreshes the duration instead of stacking. Extend Time adds 4 seconds per augment, Duration Down shortens it. The mark itself does no damage - it is a target designator that Arcane Missile and Splitting understand.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_parasit: How it works: when the spell hits a creature, a link is created from you (the caster) to it. For 8 seconds, every time you would be hurt the damage is cancelled at the very first step and dealt to the host instead - before your shield, invulnerability frames, armour, enchantments, Resistance and absorption. The host then applies its own defences. Safety rules: redirected damage is never redirected again (two players linked to each other can not bounce damage); void damage and /kill always reach you; if the host is immune to that damage type (fire on a blaze...), it takes it as parasitic transfer damage instead, so an immune host can not shield you for free. The link breaks when the host dies, goes further than 32 blocks, you die, log out or change dimension. One link at a time and a 20 second cooldown; a second hit (for example the second missile of the Focusing Gloves) neither creates a new link nor extends it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_splitti: How it works: when a projectile carrying Splitting hits a creature, two smaller turquoise homing projectiles burst from the impact point. They carry the same spell, deal 50% of its damage and seek the nearest other target - they ignore the creature that was just hit. Split projectiles never split again, so there is no chain reaction, and they cost no mana. Works with Projectile and Arcane Missile; Pursuit on the form also improves the split projectiles. Limit: one Splitting per spell.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_pursuit: How it works: each Pursuit (up to 3) adds 8 blocks to the search radius, makes the projectile turn sharper, lets it chase one target 1 second longer and lets it fly 5 seconds longer. It never changes damage. Pursuit only exists for homing forms such as Arcane Missile, because a straight projectile has nothing to improve.
